marta: Hi team — Marta here, new infra eng. Day 2. Need access help for EU project redwood-eu-research (id redwood-eu-rsrch-7): link to billing (RWD-EU-BILL: 05E6H7-EU001), KMS key access in europe-west2, and permission to create Cloud NAT + reserved static IPs. Also need an AWS cross-account read role to pull S3 logs (arn:arn:aws:iam::444333222111:role/RWD-Logs-Reader). Who should I tag for billing + security review?

ops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-9901. Please include exact KMS resource name and service account that needs access. Cloud-ops hours 08:00-18:00 CET.

oli: Welcome @marta! I can take the KMS + NAT bits. For KMS: paste the key resource (projects/.../locations/europe-west2/keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...). For NAT/static IPs we need justification; org policy limits reserve in prod. If this is non-prod, we usually approve.

marta: KMS resource: projects/redwood-eu-rsrch-7/locations/europe-west2/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/decrypt-v1. SA: runner@redwood-eu-rsrch-7.iam.gserviceaccount.com. NAT will be for eval runners (non-prod). Need 2 static IPs.

finance: Hi Marta, I'm finance. Billing account 05E6H7-EU001 exists. Reply here "link eu" and confirm export dataset name and I'll link. We typically enable billing export to bigquery dataset billing_eu_dev.

marta: link eu. Please export to billing_eu_dev. Also added AWS role ARN to ONB-9901.

oli: Thanks — will add IAM binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for runner SA on decrypt-v1. For NAT + static IPs I'll request quota and check org-policy exception for non-prod. Example I'll run:

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding decrypt-v1 \
  --location=europe-west2 --keyring=artifacts \
  --member=\"serviceAccount:runner@redwood-eu-rsrch-7.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\"
```

And I'll open network exception request for 2 static IPs.

security: Quick note: We need to review access patterns before granting static IPs due to data exfil risk. Please add the justification to ONB-9901 (what services will egress and destinations). Also for AWS cross-account we'll require the principal ARN and an external-id.

marta: Added justification: NAT only for model eval outbound to public package registries; no inbound expected. CI principal for AWS assume: arn:aws:sts::777666555444:assumed-role/ci-runner. External-id: redwood-eu-rsrch.

dmitri: Billing link done and export enabled to billing_eu_dev. KMS IAM binding queued; NAT/static IP exception submitted. AWS trust configured; ben (ops) will post assume-role snippet. Ops assigned: oli. Expect next update in ~4 hours.

marta: Amazing, thanks all! I'll try a test job once NAT is in place and report back. :sparkles:
